open_blocking.title: Criterion 3 unmet: unknown keys in 9 nested envelope objects are not pinned; removing any of those exactRecord checks admits the envelope and no test fails
open_blocking.evidence: worker/src/providerDispatchEnvelope.ts calls exactRecord for the sourceFiles item (:262), outboundFiles item (:282), envelope id/version (:297), admission (:340), affirmations (:341), scope (:347), task (:354), permit (:361) and rollout (:362). The fixture pins unknown keys only at the top level (v1.json:300 'unknown top-level key') and in subject (v1.json:307 'unknown nested key', subject.customerEmail). I replaced each of the 9 calls with plainSnapshot, one at a time, in the scratch copy /dev/shm/r568c3r3sec-mut (restored after each; cmp against the worktree is clean). For every mutant, `npx vitest run` on the three targeted suites still reports 265 passed (265). Witness: expected = presented = golden, with `grantOverride: true` added to that object, under fixture admittedEvidence. The original returns {admitted:false, denial:'envelope_malformed'} in all 9 cases. Each mutant returns {admitted:true, envelopeFingerprint:'f3e0cb1f9139b856112db3692bb4b7c83296b98d71cc9f26326e1be8fcfce4cb'}, so the unknown key is silently dropped. The binding criterion says 'unknown keys and versions fail closed; mutation on scratch copies shows the matrix catches a removed check'.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add one malformed row for each object, each giving envelope_malformed: envelope.grantOverride, admission.grantOverride, affirmations.grantOverride, scope.grantOverride, task.grantOverride, permit.grantOverride, rollout.grantOverride, sourceFiles.0.grantOverride and outboundFiles.0.grantOverride. Then re-run the 9 mutants and record them in the killed-mutant table.

open_blocking.title: The string-type guard in matching() is not pinned: without it, a one-element array is accepted for every pattern-checked field and the envelope is admitted
open_blocking.evidence: worker/src/providerDispatchEnvelope.ts:223 `if (typeof value !== "string" || !pattern.test(value)) deny();`. RegExp.test coerces its argument with ToString, so ["lease:00000000-...457e"] matches SESSION_BINDING_ID. Mutant MT1 removes the typeof guard (`if (!pattern.test(value as string)) deny();`), and the three suites still report 265 passed (265). Witness, with expected = presented and admittedEvidence: noticeRevision, sessionBindingId, permit.permitId and scope.fingerprint, each wrapped in a one-element array. The original returns parse {ok:false, denial:'envelope_malformed'} for each. The mutant returns parse ok and admitted:true, with fingerprints 860f0a26..., 76288a90..., 90103ba6... and f0aab9da... respectively. This covers every UUID, sha256, revision, evidence-reference, envelope-id and session-binding field, and legacy permit lifting as well. No malformed row uses a non-string value for a pattern-checked field: every existing row uses a wrong string.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add malformed rows that wrap a valid value in an array, for example sessionBindingId ["lease:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000457e"] and permit.permitId ["00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000457c"], each giving envelope_malformed. Re-run MT1.

open_blocking.lens: security, data boundaries & policy (round 3, read-only, continuation lane at cf9fe9c)
open_blocking.title: The expiresAt timestamp validation is not pinned: without it, an envelope whose expiry is 'never' or an invalid date is admitted and never expires
open_blocking.evidence: worker/src/providerDispatchEnvelope.ts:366 `const expiresAt = timestamp(root.expiresAt);`. Mutant R14 replaces it with `root.expiresAt as string`, and the suites report 265 passed (265). The only expiresAt rows are 'missing expiry' (caught by exactRecord) and 'impossible expiry date' (v1.json:495, 2026-02-31). V8 rolls 2026-02-31 to 2026-03-03, which is before issuedAt, so the expiry-after-issue check denies that row instead. The 'non-canonical timestamp' row covers only issuedAt. Witness under the mutant, with expected = presented and admittedEvidence: expiresAt 'never' is admitted (admitted:true, expiresAt:'never', fingerprint f58c5c05...). Date.parse returns NaN, so both `Date.parse(expiresAt) <= Date.parse(issuedAt)` and `nowMs >= Date.parse(expiresAt)` are false and the permit never expires. '2026-13-01T00:00:00.000Z' and the non-canonical '2026-10-03T12:15:00Z' are also admitted. The original returns envelope_malformed for all three.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add malformed rows expiresAt '2026-10-03T12:15:00Z' (non-canonical) and expiresAt '2026-13-01T00:00:00.000Z' (or 'never'), each giving envelope_malformed. Re-run R14.

open_blocking.lens: security, data boundaries & policy (round 3, read-only, continuation lane at cf9fe9c)
open_blocking.title: The shared substitution matrix does not pin issuedAt or three of the five task identity fields; narrowing either comparison admits a substituted envelope and no test fails
open_blocking.evidence: providerDispatchEnvelope.ts:542 compares [issuedAt, expiresAt], but the only expiry row is 'expiry extension' (v1.json:291), which changes expiresAt only. providerDispatchEnvelope.ts:538 compares the whole task object, but the only task rows are 'task' (workQueueTaskId, v1.json:249) and 'lane' (quoteRequestLaneId, v1.json:256). Mutant C17 narrows the expiry selector to envelope.expiresAt; a presented envelope with issuedAt 2026-10-03T11:00:00.000Z is then admitted (fingerprint f3e0cb1f...), where the original gives expiry_mismatch. Mutant C19 narrows the task selector to [workQueueTaskId, quoteRequestLaneId]; presented quoteRequestId, quoteRunId and vendorQuoteResultId substitutions are each then admitted, where the original gives task_lane_mismatch. Both mutants leave 265/265 passing. ARCHITECTURE.md and the PR body call v1.json the shared SQL/TS substitution matrix for OVD-458/459, so a SQL comparison that checks only work_queue_task_id and quote_request_lane_id would pass it. Criterion 5 requires task/lane substitutions to be rejected in the shared fixtures, and criterion 3 requires the matrix to catch a removed check.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add substitution rows issuedAt '2026-10-03T11:00:00.000Z' giving expiry_mismatch, and task.quoteRequestId, task.quoteRunId and task.vendorQuoteResultId (each set to 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000045ff) giving task_lane_mismatch. Re-run C17 and C19.
